# NASA GTM alternate jet lead

NASA GTM DesignSim is a stronger small twin-turbine research platform than a generic transport surrogate for some controller studies. Its source supplies measured geometry, fuel locations, fuel-dependent inertia models, twin JetCat P70 engine positions/orientations, actuator and sensor plumbing, and a polynomial aerodynamic database.

The exact aerodynamic database is stored in `T2_polynomial_aerodatabase.mat`. This bundle records its repository path and blob SHA but does not claim to contain coefficient values that were not retrievable as raw bytes through the connected interface.
